split_boundary.train: Training images only; shuffled with seed 42; random augmentation is allowed.
split_boundary.validation: No random augmentation; used for model selection only.
split_boundary.test: Protected. The preprocessing notebook verifies only its folder structure and does not load images from it. Use once only after selecting a locked V2 candidate.

important_limitation: Contrast augmentation may modestly vary lighting, but it does not label shadows, fresh repairs, road markings, or drainage covers as No_pothole. Those cases require a separately documented external challenge set.
fit_boundary: No learned preprocessing statistics are fitted on validation or protected-test images.
status: Implementation prepared but not yet executed. Run and verify it before Version 2 modeling.
